coverage_note: Community-maintained im@sparql image-color values are not a claim of official HEX standardization. Preserves all 111 idols and 16 SideM unit colors. Of 95 groups, 765PRO ALLSTARS, 765 MILLION ALLSTARS, MILLIONSTARS, 315 ALLSTARS and 315 STARS use official-portal brand display accents; the other 74 roster-based units use member-color gradients. Brand accents and inferred gradients are not official group image-color standards. Roster lists do not infer the singers in an individual track. Akizuki Ryo uses the SideM catalog color. Project LUMINOUS and THE IDOLM@STER FIVE STARS!!!!! remain unassigned.
